task:
UI redesign phase 2d — bring the Explore map window to the owner's concept (`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-ui-concept-pack/02-map.png`, with `01-finder.png` for the surrounding Finder; read `README.md`, `HANDOFF.txt`, `journey-notes.txt` in the same folder first). START from current `main`, which now includes P2b (#1009, merged as 0d7659e3: `ExploreMapWindow.svelte`, route-owned `ExploreViewState` map fields); if `ExploreMapWindow.svelte` is not on main, stop and say so. apps/web only; no backend, route, API-request, renderer-algorithm, scene-contract, layer-provenance, or `routes/+page.svelte` change. No new dependencies. Do not add Explore task tabs (that is P2c). Keep every P2b behaviour and test: topmost Escape, focus return, one SpatialCanvas per route visit, disposal on close, no search/catalogue/density/nebula requests from open/expand/close/resize, reduced motion, non-modal at every width, state in ExploreViewState.

WHY: the owner compared the built window with the concept. The concept's map is large and the controls sit under it; the built window stacks controls above a squashed canvas (at 1280x800 expanded the window is taller than the screen, so it has an inner scrollbar and the map's bottom is cut off; at 390x844 the map gets about a quarter of the screen). The images are reference for styling and PLACEMENT only. Their drawn galaxy is illustrative; use the existing renderer, real coordinates and regions. Do not claim pixel fidelity.

WHAT THE CONCEPT SHOWS (build the equivalents that the existing app can truthfully support):
1. Header: window title "<selected system name> · Galaxy map" (fallback "Galaxy map" when nothing is selected), Expand and Close controls (keep Restore size wording/aria-pressed behaviour).
2. Second row: a Local | Galaxy segmented control, a "Regions 42" chip and the existing Layers control. Local/Galaxy are CAMERA PRESETS ONLY via the existing camera-request path (Galaxy = the existing all-regions overview camera; Local = focus on the selected system at the existing local distance). Do not add a new scene mode, request or data. If no system is selected, Local is disabled with an accessible reason. The Regions chip opens the existing region picker / All 42 regions / View selected controls in a non-modal pop-out registered in popout-stack (Escape/focus-return like Layers); keep every existing region behaviour and data-attribute used by tests.
3. The canvas is the main thing: it fills the remaining window height (flex, not fixed clamp heights). At 1280x800 with the window open, and expanded, the window must fit the viewport with NO inner scrollbar at default content and the canvas at least 60 percent of the window height; at 390x844 the window fills the workspace and the canvas is at least 55 percent of the viewport height. No page-level horizontal overflow at 1280, 768 or 390 wide that was not already present on main (check and report; fix if caused by the window).
4. Control bar BELOW the canvas: zoom in/out, a Top down | Tilted segmented pair, Reset view, rotate and Up/Down (keep all existing camera controls and their keyboard equivalents and aria labels), and "Centre on <system>" when a system is selected. Range/grid readout stays. Sources: move the map-note/provenance text into a "Sources" pop-out one click away. Do NOT remove or hide any attribution or rights text: the nebula/EDAstro attribution and rights notice stay exactly as they are in Layers, and region/catalogue provenance stays reachable.
5. Footer of the window: "Back to results" (same as Close) and a primary orange "Inspect <system>" action using the existing Inspect href / followInspect path (keep "Plan here" reachable). The selected-system card and selection-status text must not push the canvas down: show them compactly (one line) or inside the footer/pop-out, keeping all existing data-attributes and roles that tests use.
6. Styling: kit tokens only (--panel, --panel-gloss, --radius-lg, --radius-pill, --neon, --accent, --line-glow). Rounded glossy window with a neon-blue edge glow as in the concept, selected result row keeps the existing selected treatment. No per-page palette, no new fonts.

TESTS AND EVIDENCE: update ExploreMapWindow.test.ts, ExploreWorkspace(.workload).test.ts, MapLayers.test.ts and Cypress product-journey/spatial-foundation. Add Cypress assertions for the layout numbers in items 3 (window scrollHeight <= clientHeight at default, canvas height ratios) at 1280x800 and 390x844, keep the axe, reduced-motion, single-canvas and request-count checks, and keep the product/explore-map-expanded-* screenshots plus add product/explore-map-window-open-* (non-expanded, desktop and phone) so the owner can compare against 02-map.png. Run pnpm check/lint/format:check/test/build and the touched Python contract pins. Plan doc: mark P2d implemented in this PR in section 4 and say the concept pack folder is the reference for placement/styling. CHANGES entry headed exactly `## 2026-11-03 — UI redesign P2d: map window to concept`. PR body: list what each concept element maps to, what was deliberately not built (and why: e.g. no new scene modes), before/after window and canvas sizes at both viewports, and confirm request counts unchanged.
